rows.text: An Order of the President dated 13 January 1990, published the same day by the Ministry of Home Affairs, begins 'Whereas I, R. Venkataraman, President of India, have received a report' from the Administrator of the Union Territory of Delhi; under section 31 of the Delhi Administration Act, 1966 it suspends listed provisions for four months, dissolves the Metropolitan Council and ends the Executive Councillors' offices. It is signed R. Venkataraman, President of India.
